items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) again for Sunday vs. Patriots; remains week-to-week.
items.why: Quad injury; no practice, ruled out.
items.implication: Continued heavy snap share to Braelon Allen (90 snaps in recent full games).
items.opportunity: Near-every-down RB role for Allen; elevated handcuff value.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee) and S Jalen Pitre will not travel to London and ruled out vs. Jaguars.
items.why: Groin injury; no travel for London game.
items.implication: Full snaps/touches to backup RB (Woody Marks per reports handled 98% prior).
items.opportunity: Lead back role expansion for Texans RB2/handcuff in London matchup.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled out vs. Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; out indefinitely per reports as treatment determined, Tanner McKee to start.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in small superficial blood clot after earlier clearance to play in London; health priority.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles pass catchers and RBs face uncertainty in volume/efficiency without Hurts dual-threat.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes possible for Dallas Goedert and DeVonta Smith if active; handcuff/backup QB streaming.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice DNP again (hamstring); Ravens QB Lamar Jackson DNP (ankle); Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant.
items.why: Multiple DNPs for Rice/Lamar; Caleb progressing to full.
items.implication: Rice high injury risk WR3; Lamar uncertain (Huntley backup); Caleb likely return candidate.
items.opportunity: If Rice out: Worthy/others elevated; monitor Lamar Friday for Ravens pass catchers.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs. Commanders secondary; ranks him WR4 for Week 6. All-in due to matchup and usage (high target share, especially without Deebo).
items.why: Washington defense buffet for pass catchers; Evans season-high target share recently, depth thin behind him.
items.opportunity: High target/route share in favorable matchup.

items.text: LOVE Drake London vs. CHI; ranks WR6. Bankable usage in solid spot.
items.why: Reliable role and volume vs. Bears.

items.text: LOVE Kyren Williams vs. ARI as RB5; elite recent usage and leaking run defense.
items.why: Volume and matchup vs. Cardinals run D.

items.text: LOVE Rhamondre Stevenson vs. NYJ as RB9; volume spike with TreVeyon Henderson out multi-weeks (85% snaps/23 touches prior absence).
items.why: Henderson high-ankle multi-week; Stevenson averages 16.3 PPG on 15+ touches historically.

items.text: Cardinals trade Marvin Harrison Jr. to HOU; Evan Silva/Adam Levitan: Kendrick Bourne will get open more and earn more targets than MHJ did.
items.why: MHJ departure opens targets in Cardinals offense for Bourne and others.
items.implication: Bourne target upgrade; MHJ new role in HOU to monitor.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for ARI WRs remaining.

items.text: Since Breece Hall injury, RB snaps in two full games: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0. Hall remains week-to-week, no practice.
items.why: Snap data shows Allen dominating workload in Hall's absence.
items.implication: Allen is clear lead back and must-start while Hall out.
items.opportunity: Near-100% snap/carry/route share for Jets RB1 role.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz). Saquon Barkley turns 30 in Feb; if Super Bowl contender with RB need, at least call. Worth risk of year too early vs too late.
items.why: Age curve and Eagles precedent for early exits from stars; Barkley also dealing with hamstring DNP.
items.implication: Potential trade candidate ROS; monitor Eagles RB depth/handcuffs if moved.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle vs. SEA as WR28; poor recent production (most yards in one game, low otherwise) and tough matchup. Note: returned from shoulder Q in TNF.
items.why: Ugly matchup + shaky production (67% yards in one game); Sean Payton offense concerns.
items.conflict: Returned from Q shoulder mid-game TNF but still low trust.

items.text: HATE Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA toughest pass D, playing scared) and Justin Herbert (QB25 @KC low team total/scoring rut).
items.why: Nix limited deep shots under new OC; Herbert stuck in low-scoring.

items.text: Jaylen Warren monster day as Rico Dowdle’s return looms; monitor split going forward.
items.why: Warren big performance; Dowdle upgraded full participant.
items.implication: Warren still strong but share may dilute; both rosterable.
items.opportunity: PIT RB committee snaps/carries; Warren goal-line/third-down edge possible.
